description: Saatvik Green Energy Limited manufactures and sells solar photovoltaic modules in India and internationally. The company offers mono PERC and N-topcon modules; inverters; SuryaConnect Solar Kit, a pre-engineered turnkey solar kit; transformers; and solar cell technology products. It also provides solar pumps, such as solar submersible and surface pumps and controllers; and engineering, procurement, and construction services. In addition, the company offers residential rooftop, commercial rooftop, institutional rooftop, ground mounted, floating solar, and carport services; and battery energy storage system services. Saatvik Green Energy Limited was incorporated in 2015 and is based in Gurugram, India.
